metadata.title: Profit Calculator — Know your real profit in 10 seconds
metadata.description: Free profit, margin, selling price and break-even calculators for small businesses. No signup needed.

home.heroTitle: Know your real profit in 10 seconds.
home.heroSubtitle: Simple calculators for shops, home sellers, drivers and market sellers.
home.toolsSubtitle: Results update as you type. Share them on WhatsApp.
home.saveBody: Add sales and costs each evening and see your profit for the whole month.

profit.name: Profit
profit.title: Profit calculator
profit.intro: Type your sales and costs. Your profit shows as you type.
profit.metaDescription: Work out your shop's profit and profit % in seconds. Add stock, rent, salary and other costs. Free, no signup.
profit.empty: Type your sales to see your profit.
profit.shareProfit: My profit today: {amount} ({pct}). Calculate yours free: {link}
profit.shareProfitNoPct: My profit today: {amount}. Calculate yours free: {link}
profit.shareLoss: My result today: a loss of {amount}. Calculate yours free: {link}
profit.guideFormula: Profit = Sales − all costs. Profit % = Profit ÷ Sales × 100.
profit.guideExample: Sales Rs 25,000, stock Rs 15,000 and other costs Rs 1,500. Profit = 25,000 − 16,500 = Rs 8,500, which is 34% of sales.

margin.name: Margin
margin.description: Profit per item, margin and markup.
margin.title: Margin calculator
margin.intro: Type what one item costs you and what you sell it for.
margin.metaTitle: Free profit margin and markup calculator
margin.metaDescription: Find the profit per item, margin % and markup % from cost and selling price. Free, no signup.
margin.quantityHint: How many items you sell. Leave empty for 1.
margin.marginVsMarkup: Margin is profit as a share of the selling price. Markup is profit as a share of the cost.
margin.totalProfit: Total profit for {quantity, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
margin.totalLoss: Total loss for {quantity, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
margin.empty: Type the cost and selling price to see your margin.
margin.shareProfit: Cost {cost}, price {price}: profit {amount} per item ({margin} margin). Calculate yours free: {link}
margin.shareLoss: Cost {cost}, price {price}: loss {amount} per item. Calculate yours free: {link}
margin.guideTitle: How to calculate margin and markup
margin.guideFormula: Profit per item = Price − Cost. Margin % = Profit ÷ Price × 100. Markup % = Profit ÷ Cost × 100.
margin.guideExample: Cost Rs 85, price Rs 110, 100 items. Profit per item Rs 25, margin 22.7%, markup 29.4%, total profit Rs 2,500.

price.name: Selling price
price.description: The right price for the profit you want.
price.title: Selling price calculator
price.intro: Find the price that gives you the profit you want.
price.metaDescription: Find the right selling price from your cost and the markup or margin you want. Free, no signup.

breakEven.name: Break-even
breakEven.description: Sales you need to cover your costs.
breakEven.title: Break-even calculator
breakEven.intro: See how much you must sell to cover your monthly costs.
breakEven.metaDescription: Find the sales you need each month and each day to cover your fixed costs. Free, no signup.
